codebook_feedback: Main-goal rule vs A6 close call: in 'X so that I can share with my psychologist' (6929d658) X matches no A code, so A6 had to be main. Rule 6 skips process goals but does not say whether 'find credible information quickly' (69a1ae3c) counts as saying why AI was used. A1 vs A4 is hard when a known medicine/condition is named and they ask why a body change happens (69fe1811 Zepbound hair, 616f347d eye condition causes, 66d8e4c1 'learn about something going on with my body'). A8 vs A4 when the goal is 'basic knowledge about the subject matter' with no topic named (6ae359af). 'Am I healthy or not' (6952e59d) is between A1 and A2. 'Signs and symptoms of chest pain' (671a8337) between A4 and A1. A6 vs A2 for 'when to call the hospital' about a planned induction (66aafcc3). T-doctor: unclear whether 'tips as to scheduling an appointment' (5f491a49) or 'symptoms the AI told me about I will seek medical care' (67d5d3b7) count. W2 vs W1 when the person was directed to a professional and left uncertain (697cba85). B1 vs B2 when a yes is followed by 'a real person's opinion is still necessary' (6ac2aee8).
